title: Add Firecracker executor profile behind SecurityExecutionEngine

summary.firecracker_boundary: Firecracker is represented as a FirecrackerExecutor profile binding compiled by LeaseSandboxProfileCompiler and attached through DefaultSecurityExecutionEngine::prepare after policy allow and CapabilityLease acquisition.
summary.no_direct_executor: No Firecracker helper or direct command execution path was added; high-risk steps still use the SecurityExecutionEngine controlled-effect path.
summary.authority: Profile metadata is derived from CapabilityLease plus SEF-controlled FirecrackerProfileRequest. Planner sandbox hints are recorded as ignored reasons and cannot weaken profile constraints.
summary.audit: EffectPrepared includes the policy reason and execution profile summary. PreparedStepExecution JSON and explain output expose the selected Firecracker binding without secrets.
summary.snapshot_and_host_trust: Audit summary records host_trust=same-host-trusted and snapshot_trust=not-portable; Firecracker snapshots are not treated as portable cross-host rollback artifacts.

dependency_check_behavior.missing_dependency_result: compile_firecracker returns InvalidProfile before EffectEnvelope::prepare, so no EffectPrepared audit event is emitted.
dependency_check_behavior.host_without_firecracker: Hosts without KVM, Firecracker, jailer, kernel image, or rootfs image fail closed with a message containing 'firecracker dependencies missing' and 'no host fallback is allowed'.

acceptance_evidence.firecracker_cannot_execute_outside_secur: Only StepExecutionRequest::with_firecracker_profile reaches compile_firecracker inside DefaultSecurityExecutionEngine::prepare; no standalone Firecracker runner was added.
acceptance_evidence.planner_output_cannot_weaken_profile_con: PlannerSandboxHints are serialized, secret-checked, and converted to ignored_planner_hints; profile CPU, memory, network mode, block devices, image paths, and snapshot policy come from the SEF request and lease.
acceptance_evidence.missing_dependencies_fail_closed: firecracker_missing_dependency_fails_before_effect_prepare asserts PolicyEvaluated exists and EffectPrepared does not.
acceptance_evidence.audit_records_profile_selection_and_poli: firecracker_profile_requires_policy_approval_before_prepare asserts EffectPrepared contains firecracker_profile and policy_reason.
